source.extractionPreview:
Physical and 
Motor Fitness
UNIT 2
This unit focuses on improving heart health, 
muscular strength, and agility through structured 
exercises and activities. Students will enhance 
their running, jumping, and movement skills 
while learning proper techniques for endurance 
and strength training. They will also explore the 
importance of warm-up and cool-down routines, 
ensuring injury prevention and muscle recovery.
